Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, a frail but determined man. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Great Honor To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live To The One And Only JACOB!

The room erupts in applause as Jacob is presented with the plaque. He holds it tightly, a mix of emotions on his face.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the plaque still clutched in his hand. He looks up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes.

JACOB (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born In A Multiverse, And Every Time You Died, You Would Reincarnate In A Parallel Universe, Then You Would Eventually Live Forever.

Jacob's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

JACOB (V.O) (CONT'D)
I Never Thought Much Of It At The Time, But Now... Now I'm Not So Sure.

Suddenly, Jacob's expression changes. His eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and despair.

JACOB (V.O) (CONT'D)
What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Infinite Parallel Universes, And I'm Reincarnating In Each One? What If I've Been Reincarnating For Centuries, And I'll Never Be Able To Escape?

Jacob's voice rises to a fever pitch as he becomes overwhelmed by the implications.

JACOB (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'M NOT JUST 127 YEARS OLD, I'M A DROP IN THE OCEAN OF POSSIBILITIES! I'M A DROP IN THE OCEAN OF REALITIES!

The camera zooms in on Jacob's face as he begins to break down. He starts to sob uncontrollably, his body shaking with sobs.

CUT TO:

EXT. JACOB'S HOUSE - NIGHT

The camera pans out to reveal Jacob's house, bathed in the soft glow of moonlight. The sound of Jacob's sobs echoes through the night air, a haunting reminder of the weight of his newfound knowledge.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
